v0.2.9 Attribution Rules

Roster source: the normalized 2026–2027 Parent Contacts file embedded in this build. Matching: SignUpGenius volunteer email is compared case-insensitively. Credit: one represented program receives 100% of the volunteer's hours; two receive 50% each; three receive 33.3% each. Event type does not determine program credit. Review: only emails absent from the roster remain unmatched.
